mintAuthority.summary: srUSD's Ethereum Savingcoin is the sole reviewed native-issuance route and is minted only by Savings Module 0x5475... (MINTER role confirmed). DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0xb7570e32...; the wrapper has no proxy/upgrade path. Base rUSD mint authority remains inherited from Reservoir PSM/Credit Enforcer controls, while the Berachain LayerZero OFT and Ethereum OFT adapter are Bridge Risk machinery.

controls.label: srUSD Savingcoin token (non-upgradeable, AccessControl)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295219: Blockscout confirms Savingcoin contract (not a proxy, no EIP-1967 slots). Creation block 20564153 RoleGranted: DEFAULT_ADMIN initially to deployer 0x6ed13690... then transferred to EOA 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602 (block 20564168). Current: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN, 0xb7570e32) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN, deployer) = false. eth_getCode(0xb7570e32) = 0x (EOA).

controls.label: Reservoir Savings Module (MINTER on srUSD)
controls.evidence: RoleGranted event at block 20564156 granted role 0x77d856470f7c160c0ed7528eb012b172cfb4efe46afb11f608d3b87e41043bef to 0x5475611dffb8ef4d697ae39df9395513b6e947d7 (Savings Module). Current: hasRole(0x77d856..., SavingsModule) = true at block 25295219. Savings Module mints srUSD only against rUSD deposits, does not create base rUSD.

controls.label: Inherited Reservoir Credit Enforcer
controls.evidence: srUSD inherits base rUSD mint-path risk from Reservoir rUSD controls, including the Credit Enforcer listed in official docs. Tracked separately on parent rusd-reservoir.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771151, srUSD is a non-upgradeable Savingcoin token and the Savings Module 0x5475611dffb8ef4d697ae39df9395513b6e947d7 holds its MINTER role. DEFAULT_ADMIN is the code-empty EOA 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602. The native liability path is the Ethereum srUSD wrapper and inherited rUSD controls; the Berachain SrusdOft and Ethereum MyOFTAdapter are cross-chain machinery and are excluded from Mint Authority.
